docs_version_reference: XGrammar 0.2.8 public docs + mlc-ai/xgrammar main converter sources (paper only; not installed)

proceed_only_if: no required semantic feature is documented unsupported
no evidence shows XGrammar necessarily weakens the frozen schema
remaining uncertainty is empirical/constructibility rather than a known contract mismatch

gates.requirement: Hard token-level masking during decode; not post-hoc validation-only.
gates.evidence: XGrammar constrained-decoding docs: per-step token bitmask applied to logits (−∞ for illegal tokens). HF path: xgr.contrib.hf.LogitsProcessor(compiled_grammar).
gates.rationale: Public architecture is explicit token-mask constrained decoding via GrammarMatcher.fill_next_token_bitmask / HF LogitsProcessor.

gates.requirement: Exact support for the frozen patched ClosedNormalizedProgram JSON Schema artifact (full nesting, enums, nullables, XOR patch).
gates.evidence: compile_json_schema accepts schema string/dict/Pydantic; Draft 2020-12 subset documented. No public attestation that our exact persisted artifact compiles.
gates.rationale: Feature surface is broadly present, but fidelity to our exact artifact is empirical.

gates.requirement: Exact XOR oneOf for ClosedSemanticQuery branches (text-only vs local_ref-only); reject both/neither.
gates.evidence: DeepWiki/source: oneOf is supported but may fall back to anyOf semantics when branches are not provably disjoint; open PR #672 documents that oneOf was compiled as union and proposes fail-closed for non-disjoint cases. Our branches are exclusive object shapes (required keys + additionalProperties:false), which should be generative-disjoint, but paper does not prove acceptance parity for our probes.
gates.rationale: Not documented as UNSUPPORTED; residual risk is exact XOR parity under current oneOf/anyOf handling → Stage B probes required. Not a known necessary weakening of our exclusive-property XOR shape.

gates.requirement: pattern ".*\\S.*" on text/local_ref matching Pydantic strip()!="" (reject empty/whitespace including tab; accept surrounded whitespace).
gates.evidence: String pattern keyword is supported and converted via RegexConverter (ECMA-262 subset). Documented regex limits exclude backrefs, assertions, Unicode property escapes, {x,y} — not used by .*\\S.*. Exact tab/escape fidelity against JSON string encoding is unproven on paper (Outlines failed here).
gates.rationale: pattern is not documented unsupported; our specific non-whitespace contract still needs construction/parity probes.

gates.requirement: additionalProperties:false enforced on closed objects (incl. XOR branches and ClosedModel surfaces).
gates.evidence: Object additionalProperties / unevaluatedProperties handled in converter; strict_mode default true enforces unevaluatedProperties/Items false. PR #594 tests additionalProperties:false with properties coexistence.
gates.rationale: Documented first-class support with strict_mode default aligned to closed schemas.

gates.evidence: Converter recognizes $defs and definitions; $ref via JSON Pointer with circular-ref handling documented.
gates.rationale: Required reference mechanism is documented supported; Stage B still verifies our exact $ref graph compiles.

gates.requirement: ACCEPT text-only / local_ref-only; REJECT both / neither (PREFLIGHT parity).
gates.evidence: Depends on G2a oneOf handling; exclusive property grammars under choice should reject both-fields if additionalProperties:false is honored per branch.
gates.rationale: Paper does not prove our XOR probe suite; not a documented hard unsupported.

gates.requirement: Reject empty/whitespace-only including tab; accept non-whitespace with optional surrounding spaces.
gates.evidence: Same as G2b; PREFLIGHT-01R showed Outlines false-accepted tab via JSON escape — XGrammar must be probed identically.
gates.rationale: Empirical gate; pattern keyword alone is insufficient proof.

gates.requirement: Compatible with exact pinned local Qwen3-1.7B tokenizer (HF fast tokenizer path).
gates.evidence: TokenizerInfo.from_huggingface documented; supports HF fast/tiktoken/SentencePiece. Official tests use Qwen tokenizers. Vocab-size caveat: pass config.vocab_size when logits dim ≠ tokenizer vocab.
gates.rationale: In-principle HF/Qwen support is documented; exact local snapshot must be proven in Stage B without weight load.

gates.requirement: compile_json_schema + matcher/logits-processor construction succeeds for full patched schema without DFA/state blow-up.
gates.evidence: XGrammar uses grammar compilation + adaptive token-mask cache (different engine than outlines_core Index). No public guarantee for our schema size/complexity. PREFLIGHT-01R outlines_core failed with DFA state limit — non-transferable proof either way.
gates.rationale: Primary empirical reason Stage B exists; paper cannot clear this gate.

gates.requirement: No semantic repair, soft validation-and-fix, or schema weakening in the constraint path.
gates.evidence: Documented mechanism is generative masking only. No XGrammar feature described as post-decode semantic normalization of operands/ops. Unsupported schema features are listed as warn/best-effort for not/if/uniqueItems — not used by our frozen schema.
gates.rationale: Architecture is preventative token masking; Stage B must still refuse any repair wrapper.

gates.requirement: Deterministic, pinnable artifact/version provenance for backend + compiled constraint.
gates.evidence: Released versions on GitHub/PyPI (docs tagged 0.2.8); compile_json_schema is a pure function of schema + TokenizerInfo + compile kwargs (strict_mode, separators, etc.). Stage B must pin exact xgrammar version + hash compiled artifact.
gates.rationale: Version pinning path exists on paper; construction probe records concrete hashes.

gates.requirement: Unsupported/unsound constructs fail closed rather than silently widening the language.
gates.evidence: Satisfiability checks reject some impossible schemas. Historical oneOf→anyOf fallback is a known non-fail-closed path for overlapping oneOf (PR #672). Our XOR shape is exclusive-properties; Stage B must verify compile errors or exact reject behavior for required probes, with no silent widening.
gates.rationale: Not a blanket UNSUPPORTED, but fail-closed for our oneOf/pattern edge cases is unproven.

residual_risks: oneOf may compile as anyOf when not provably disjoint; must verify XOR probes on our exclusive-property branches
full-schema compile may still explode or OOM despite different engine
config.vocab_size vs tokenizer vocab_size must be pinned for Qwen logits dim
strict_mode/separators/any_order kwargs must be frozen to match canonical schema serialization
stage_a_disposition_meaning: No documented incompatibility blocks an empirical construction probe. Does NOT authorize install, code, Stage B, or PILOT-01.
